rules.rule: Do not promote a strategy whose available profit factor is below 1 or whose average net R is non-positive.
Do not rescue a structurally negative strategy family with small threshold changes alone.
Always review fee and slippage stress before interpreting raw return.
High trade count without positive per-trade edge is evidence of noise amplification, not diversification.
Never treat missing metrics as zero or as passing evidence.
Signal edge and account-path risk must pass independently; one layer cannot hide failure in the other.
Martingale and inverse-averaging designs remain rejected regardless of short-sample headline return.
Archived strategies are negative research assets and cannot become executable without a new version and fresh evidence.
